Drawing upon Morgrave University fieldwork, you instantly analyze the structural stress, magical composition, or anatomical flaws of your target. Target one hazard, mechanism, relic, or creature within 30 feet.

  • Hazard or Object: You gain a +2 status bonus to Perception checks to notice hidden components and Thievery or Crafting checks to Disable, Repair, or unlock the target for 1 minute.
  • Creature: You instantly Recall Knowledge about the creature with a +1 status bonus. In addition, your next Strike or spell attack against that creature before the end of your current turn gains a +1 status bonus to the attack roll.

Heightened (4th): The bonus against hazards increases to +3, and the bonus to your next attack roll increases to +2.
